algorithm.candidate_duplicate_verification: direct canonical raw-value byte equality for every observed candidate duplicate group; SHA-256 used to split effective-128-bit collisions
algorithm.candidate_fingerprint: two deterministic pandas 64-bit row hashes with independent fixed hash keys over the exact ordered frozen raw model-input view
algorithm.categorical_value_rule: exact parsed source string with deterministic missing sentinel
algorithm.numeric_value_rule: numeric model columns canonicalized as float64; NaN/+Inf/-Inf have explicit deterministic byte sentinels

mixed_label_future_rule: remain intact; never enter benign_weight_train, benign_early_stop, or benign_threshold_calibration; later allocate indivisibly to development or final test
same_label_duplicate_future_rule: all rows sharing feature_fingerprint remain in one future partition
